visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long hair, wearing a brown t-shirt and a necklace, speaks toward the camera. In front of him, a close-up of a glass bowl filled with white yogurt and chunks of chocolate-coated protein bars is shown. Yellow captions with pink outlines appear at the top. The background is a brightly lit indoor space with neutral tones. (2) The scene shifts to a white box labeled 'Body Goals' and several individually wrapped protein bars laid out on a woven mat. The camera pans across five different flavors of the bars. The lighting is soft and natural, emphasizing the product packaging. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a dark chocolate protein bar, then a white chocolate one. The texture of the coatings and the puffed grains inside are clearly visible. A wooden table and a white plate serve as the background context. (4) The man in the brown shirt takes a bite of a white chocolate bar, closing his eyes in delight. Heart and bubble graphics float around him against a plain grey studio wall. He holds the packaging in his left hand while gesturing with his right. (5) Another man wearing a khaki cap and a grey t-shirt enters the frame from the right. He holds a protein shaker bottle and interacts with the first man, offering him a different protein bar. They are sitting on a grey sofa in a minimalist living room. (6) The first man is seen eating the yogurt and protein bar mixture from a clear glass bowl with a spoon. Yellow flower graphics appear around him as he expresses enjoyment. The setting remains the indoor studio area. (7) The video concludes with a shot of the 'Body Goals' protein bar box and a text overlay containing a discount code. The second man's hand is seen dipping a whole protein bar into the yogurt bowl while the first man looks on with a surprised expression.

A crisp 'pop' SFX is heard simultaneously with the appearance of a new flavor title. The BGM maintains its bright, major-key tonality. (3) Multiple 'ding' sound effects trigger in rapid succession, marking the listing of different product flavors. The vocal remains clear with a rising intonation pattern, conveying excitement. (4) A distinctive 'crunch' sound effect is audible as the speaker bites into the protein bar. This is followed by a whimsical, bubbling 'pop' SFX associated with the visual heart graphics. The BGM remains consistent in volume. (5) A second male voice enters with a slightly deeper pitch but similar high arousal. A 'thud' sound of a protein shaker being placed or handled is briefly heard. The two voices overlap slightly in a conversational, enthusiastic manner. The vocal intensity increases during the description of the protein content. (7) The audio concludes with a final 'ding' SFX as the discount code is mentioned. The BGM ends with a clean fade-out, while the first speaker lets out a small, surprised gasp accompanied by a comical 'boing' sound effect.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Showcase -> Personal Experience -> Social Validation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote 'Body Goals' protein bars by positioning them as a low-calorie, high-protein dessert alternative. It uses personal taste testing and creative serving suggestions (like adding them to yogurt) to appeal to health-conscious viewers. The inclusion of a second character provides a secondary use case for the product as a post-workout supplement, broadening its market appeal before concluding with a clear call-to-action and discount incentive.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a specific discount code 'energydessert' and a promotional offer, while explicitly showcasing the product packaging and flavors of the 'Body Goals' brand throughout.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes popular short-form content techniques such as variety-show style subtitles, sound effect punctuation, and fast-paced editing to maintain high viewer engagement. The dual-perspective (dessert enthusiast vs. fitness enthusiast) effectively targets a wider audience demographic.
